---
title: Exercise — Load and Inspect a Fundus Image
---

## Objective

Load a JPEG fundus image, inspect its shape and dtype, and perform a round‑trip save.

## Steps

1. Use `imageio.imread` or `PIL.Image.open` to load `sample-fundus.jpg`.
2. Print `array.shape` and `array.dtype`.
3. Save the array back to PNG using `imageio.imwrite`.
4. Reload the PNG and confirm the shape/dtype are unchanged.

## Deliverable

A short script (`exercise_ndarray.py`) that performs the above and prints the values.
